meta.title: FEAT-010 — Shop settings: profile, pickup address, payout
meta.subtitle: Design solution from technical-design.md: a seller saves the shop profile, the pickup address and the payout bank details; the account number is encrypted and only its last four digits are shown. Pick a flow to follow one UC-004 path; click any arrow for its data contract.
meta.description: A seller opens Settings in the seller centre (or a checklist button on the dashboard). The pages read GET /v1/shops/me, which now returns the description, the pickup address and the payout with only the last four digits, and computes the setup checklist. Each section saves on its own PUT sub-resource under policy seller: profile (name, description), pickup-address (six free-text fields, Vietnamese phone in E.164) and payout (bank name, account number, holder). Identity validates every field together (FR-SHOP-008), encrypts the account number with AES-256-GCM using the active key from configuration and the shop id as associated data, and stores ciphertext, key id and last four digits on the shops row. A profile change, or the moment the shop's setup becomes complete, writes a ShopChanged/v1 outbox row carrying only public fields, setupComplete and a monotonic version. Nothing consumes it yet; Notification acknowledges it.
overview: FR-SHOP-005..008, FR-SHOP-010 (logo and cover deferred), NFR-SEC-008; supports FR-ROLE-003, FR-ROLE-004, FR-SHOP-009, FR-SHOP-011

PUT /v1/shops/me/profile, /pickup-address, /payout; extended GET /v1/shops/me; event ShopChanged/v1; Spectral rule hs-no-bank-number-in-responses

nodes.label: Browser
nodes.desc: The seller, signed in on the seller host (hs.bff.sel, FEAT-009). Never holds a token.

nodes.label: Seller centre SPA
nodes.desc: features/settings: ShopProfilePage at /settings/profile and PickupPayoutPage at /settings/pickup-payout (/settings redirects to the profile). Each section saves on its own and renders the returned MyShop. Payout shows •••• 1234; changing it asks for the full number again (D-4). Dashboard checklist buttons now go to /settings/pickup-payout.

nodes.label: Gateway + BFF
nodes.desc: No change: /v1/shops/{**rest} already routes to Identity with policy authenticated; non-GET calls need X-HS-CSRF: 1; the access token is relayed as a bearer.

nodes.label: Identity
nodes.desc: Three PUT handlers plus the extended GET /v1/shops/me. Validates every field together, checks rename uniqueness, encrypts the account number through IBankAccountProtector (AES-256-GCM), retries up to 3 times on a row-version conflict, and queues ShopChanged when the public profile or readiness changes.

nodes.label: identitydb
nodes.desc: shops gains description, profile_version, six pickup_* columns and five payout_* columns (ciphertext bytea, last4, key_id), both groups all-or-none by check; xmin row version. Migration AddShopSettings.

nodes.label: Bank key
nodes.desc: Identity:BankEncryption: ActiveKeyId and Keys:{id} (32 bytes, base64). Locally generated by the AppHost's DevSecrets into .local/dev-secrets; deployed from the vault (FEAT-037). Validated at start-up.

nodes.label: Service Bus
nodes.desc: One topic; subscriptions exist for inventory and notification only.

nodes.label: Notification
nodes.desc: No handler for ShopChanged: inbox row, acknowledged, no email.

nodes.label: Catalog / Search-AI
nodes.desc: Not in this slice. Catalog (FEAT-011/012) keeps a shop snapshot and enforces FR-SHOP-011 from setupComplete; Search-AI (FEAT-018) shows the shop name.

all.title: FEAT-010 design solution
all.intro: Open settings, save profile, pickup address and payout, and the refused paths.

steps.t: Open settings from the sidebar or a dashboard checklist button; GET /v1/shops/me relayed with the bearer.
Read the caller's shop; the payout is mapped to accountNumberLast4; setup is computed from what exists.
200 MyShop: profile, pickup address, bank name, holder and •••• 4567.
Submit name and description; PUT /v1/shops/me/profile.
Validate both fields; if the normalized name changed, check no other shop holds it.
Update the profile, profile_version + 1, outbox ShopChanged, one commit.
Event relayed after commit; Notification acknowledges it; 200 MyShop.
Submit six fields; PUT /v1/shops/me/pickup-address.
Store trimmed text and the phone in E.164; ShopChanged only if this completes setup.
200 MyShop with setup.pickupAddress: true.
Submit bank name, full account number and holder; PUT /v1/shops/me/payout.
Encrypt the digits with AES-256-GCM under the active key; associated data = shop id.
Store ciphertext, key id and last four digits; no payout is started; ShopChanged if setup is now complete.
Readiness event (setupComplete: true) when this save completes setup.
200 MyShop with accountNumberLast4 only; the checklist shows complete.
Submit a section with several bad fields.
400 common.validation_failed with one details entry per field; nothing saved, no event.
Errors shown next to their fields; the first one gets focus.
Submit a name another shop holds, in any case or spacing.
Name check finds it (or the unique index loses the race at commit).
409 identity.shop_name_taken shown on the name field; nothing changed.

notes.b: Key id stored per row for rotation; shop id as associated data so a ciphertext cannot move between shops. Rejected: Data Protection, Key Vault envelope.
Each screen section saves on its own; a whole-shop PUT would have to resend the masked number.

notes.t: Payout PUT needs the full number
notes.b: Only the last four digits ever leave Identity, so a masked value cannot round-trip.
Address and payout are one-per-shop attributes; no new table or entity, no escalation.
Private fields stay in Identity; FEAT-012 enforces FR-SHOP-011 from its own snapshot.
Description 1000, address 80/60/200, bank fields 2–80, account number 6–19 digits. Confirm at review.

notes.t: Row version + bounded retry, no If-Match
notes.b: Existing concurrency pattern; last-write-wins per section; protects version and readiness transition.
FR-SHOP-010 shows them; they arrive with FEAT-035/036.
The first consumer needs its subscription before demo shops exist, or a backfill of ShopRegistered and the latest ShopChanged.
Kept required as FR-SHOP-006 states (D-2, user decision); an SRS note is suggested to make it optional for FR-SHOP-006 and FR-ADDR-001.
